metadata.description: Broad, shallow, recent coverage driven by an exam syllabus rather than the prerequisite graph. Passes advanced topics without the foundations underneath them and overrates their own understanding.
metadata.disclaimer: Synthetic research persona generated by stepzero.student_profiles. This is designed test material, not observed data, and it is not derived from or calibrated against any real student. It exists to give Project Step Zero v1.0 controlled, reproducible inputs for recommendation, simulation, and evaluation experiments, and is expected to be replaced or calibrated once primary research data is collected.
design_notes: The only persona that studies out of prerequisite order, which is the behaviour it exists to stress-test.
chemical_equilibrium, ph_and_buffers, and integrals are crammed, mastered on paper while their prerequisites were never opened.
Hours per concept are the lowest of any persona and the mastery bar is the lowest, so the learner moves on quickly.
Confidence is biased upward, the mirror image of the struggling persona.
limits is a deliberate gap, the module was passed without the idea ever landing.
